vsr: polite: Lyon sits where the Rhone meets the Saone, about four hundred kilometres southeast of Paris. Its old town is a protected heritage site, known for narrow covered passages called traboules. - Take the funicular up Fourviere hill. - Eat at a traditional bouchon. - Walk the Croix-Rousse slopes. Most visitors find two days enough to see the centre ZETAEND
